patterns.name: mouse_movement_without_click
patterns.tested_result: Provisional full 6s: hand and mouse move together, fingers rest on buttons. Brief downward head inclination remains. Prior click take repeatedly lifted index finger too far.
patterns.guidance: Start with cupped grip and supported wrist. Removing the click is a useful simplification candidate when it causes finger performance. Both prompt and seed changed, so not a causal prompt-only result.

patterns.name: laptop_localized_typing
patterns.tested_result: Provisional full 6s: low independent finger changes, supported arms and screen gaze. Brief mouth opening and some cadence regularity remain.
patterns.guidance: Keep ongoing work and unequal finger roles, avoid a concluding hand gesture. Inspect full duration and facial behavior as well as initial contact.

patterns.name: wrist_rest_does_not_guarantee_finger_restraint
patterns.tested_result: Rejected: wrist support improved nearer hand anchoring but far hand still over-articulates. Gaze repeatedly dips.
patterns.guidance: A supported source is necessary evidence, not a guarantee of motion. Reduce task complexity and review both hands independently.

patterns.name: desktop_reading_does_not_reliably_stop_typing
patterns.tested_result: Both full takes rejected: typing and high far-finger extensions persist despite reading/rest prompt. Only v3 2.167–3.667s selected as a 1.5s reading-pause segment.
patterns.guidance: Do not claim a reading-only prompt guarantees resting hands; retain failure tails and mark trimmed success separately. New source pose or model route needs a future bounded test.

limitations: Real clips only informed written behavioral directions; no uploaded real clip/frame, direct motion transfer or identity recreation.
No matched control, no controlled model ranking, no exact key or cursor response test.
Sampled chronological visual review, not continuous real-time playback. Scores provisional and uncalibrated.
